Dr. Victor Dean, BS, MS, DC, CPT

Dr. Dean had over 25 years of experience in the sports performance and rehab world before becoming a chiropractor. He holds a Bachelor's Degree in Exercise Science, a Master's Degree in Nutrition, and a Doctorate in Chiropractic, along with countless specialty certifications. He is also a multi-sport athlete and has overcome many injuries on his way to earning world and national titles, which enables him to offer a unique perspective when working with sports injuries. In addition to treating back and neck pain, we deal with things like sprained ankles, tennis elbow, whiplash, vertigo, headaches, plantar fasciitis, weight loss, nutritional supplements, sports nutrition, and more. Treatments often include corrective exercises, PNF stretching, and soft tissue work, such as trigger point therapy, pin and stretch, and instrument assisted soft tissue mobilization (IASTM).
